name: @versatiles/maplibre-svg-export
description: MapLibre GL JS control that exports the current map view as SVG.
author: Michael Kreil <versatiles@michael-kreil.de>

scripts.docs: npm run docs:bundle && npm run docs:graph
scripts.docs:bundle: vrt bundle-treemap dist/maplibre-svg-export.umd.min.js --depth 3 --min-size 4000 --svg docs/bundle-treemap.svg | sed -e 's#](docs/#](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/versatiles-org/versatiles-svg-renderer/main/packages/maplibre-svg-export/docs/#g' -e 's#?raw=true##g' | vrt doc-insert README.md '## Bundle Composition' && prettier --write --log-level warn README.md
scripts.docs:graph: vrt deps-graph --svg docs/dependency-graph.svg | sed -e 's#](docs/#](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/versatiles-org/versatiles-svg-renderer/main/packages/maplibre-svg-export/docs/#g' -e 's#?raw=true##g' | vrt doc-insert README.md '## Dependency Graph' && prettier --write --log-level warn README.md
